name: c2-diagnosis-checkpoint-v1
old_paragraph: - As soon as you have read the code that produces the wrong behaviour, make your edit in the very next call. Do not run more searches or re-read the same region to confirm first; verification comes after the edit.
new_paragraph: - After reading a candidate implementation, compare it with the issue’s expected behavior. Briefly identify the conflicting operation and smallest justified change, or explain why this implementation does not explain the issue. If a conflict is identified, edit next. If uncertain, perform at most one check that distinguishes two specific hypotheses before deciding. Do not repeat an unchanged check.

evaluation.status: CPU packaging only; compiler/runtime and matched repair experiments pending
evaluation.seed_contract: Use matching c2/c2-seed1 control and candidate members. The c2 control omits a sampling seed; explicitly freeze and record server seed 42. The c2-seed1 sampling seed is 1.

selection: Conditional diagnostic candidate; semantic classifications require reviewer evidence. No promotion from exposure counts alone.
